**Ambiguous Terms:**
- **Continuation-line whitespace in trigger text:** "Lines are joined with one space" doesn't say whether continuation lines are trimmed. Only the first line's surrounding whitespace is explicitly removed. I kept the leading spaces, which affects ADR-0126 and ADR-0139. If health trims each line, those two texts will differ by whitespace only.
- **Where the version-mention boundary check applies:** For `PyJWT>=2.14.0` (ADR-0131), I applied the "not preceded by a letter" check to the start of the whole match, prefix included. That rejects `>=2.14.0` and leaves `2.14.0`. If the check is meant to apply only to the digit runs, the mention would be `>=2.14.0`. Either way the class is `version`.
- **Signal-text extent:** Signal text ends only at a Mode, Signal or Owner line. So ADR-0131's `- **Residual:**` bullet counts as signal text, while prose paragraphs after the Owner line are excluded (ADR-0127, 0132, 0133). For this share, the ADR-0131 bullet happens to contain no candidates.
